item.title: ‘He’s done it so many times’; Family remembers base jumper who died in Rock Canyon accident - KSLNewsRadio

item.description: Federal investigators looking into the collision between an Air Canada jet and a fire truck at New York's LaGuardia Airport are reviewing the cockpit voice recorder and the actions inside the control tower.

item.title: Clark Planetarium to host Artemis II watch party Wednesday - KSLNewsRadio
item.description: NASA announced Tuesday that the scheduled Artemis II rocket launch has an 80% chance of happening as the weather clears and the moon aligns. The Clark Planetarium in Salt Lake City plans to host a viewing event to celebrate the historic launch.

item.title: Utah County Fire Department deploys 4th crew out of state this year - KSLNewsRadio
